scientific_integrity: The general theorem is proved by local payoff inequalities and cyclic-gap enumeration. Direct rational enumeration of 98,112 profiles provides finite cross-checks but is not represented as an infinite proof. Mathematical enumeration identities are credited to earlier authors. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats two actions, positive homogeneous spokes and unit rim weights on labeled wheels with unilateral weak Nash best responses. It does not cover unequal spoke weights, strategic deviations by coalitions or dynamics. Perrin and Lucas counts of cycle independent sets are prior known facts; publication priority of the wheel-specific phase theorem remains subject to unindexed equivalent results.
title: A sharp equilibrium and efficiency phase transition on weighted wheel networks
